response.rationale: A (Treatment Product) is a catalogue entry for a product that can be registered and listed: TreatmentProductRepository keeps a Map<string, TreatmentProduct>, and TreatmentService calls registerProduct and listProducts on it. B (Treatment) is a treatment event applied to a specific hive, retrieved with this.treatments.findByHive(hiveId). TreatmentService also calls recordTreatment and assertHarvestAllowed on the product repository, which suggests treatment records refer to products, probably to check a withholding period before harvest. So these are two related entities, not one concept under two names.
